reserveReview.rationale: Fresh write-time re-measurement 2026-07-30 replacing the 2026-07-28 unknown-weights envelope. MEASUREMENT at Sonic block 76778944 (2026-07-30T21:18:20Z, https://rpc.soniclabs.com): total bnUSD supply = facilitator bucket currentBorrowed = 1,408,507.20 bnUSD (cap 2,500,000; cross-check variableDebtToken 0x9d6658bfdf512bc08ede9ef75d64a9e5d4f321de totalSupply = 1,409,413.59, delta 0.06%). Total backing = sum of all 82 bnUSD borrowers' aToken collateral across 24 nonzero SODAX money-market reserves (SODAX backend API borrowers/positions, indexed ~1.8k blocks behind the pin), each reserve priced with the pool's own Aave oracle getAssetPrice at the pinned block = $2,918,934.98, giving collateralizationRatio 2.072361. Market-price cross-check (DefiLlama/CoinGecko majors) agrees with oracle prices within 0.1% on covered assets; hyTB and SODA have no market-price coverage and rely on the pool oracle. On-chain spot-check: whale 0x73135d19c488ea5b002e0e07135d992ff7e6f070 hyTB aToken balanceOf at the pin = 1,053,059.9039543339, exactly matching the API position read; that single account holds the entire sodahyTB slice (39.76% of backing), so concentration risk is dominated by one tokenized T-bill position. Composition: sodahyTB $1,160,456 (39.76%), sodaUSDC $692,000 (23.71%), sodaBTC $209,393 (7.17%), sodaBNB $201,630 (6.91%), sodaAVAX $108,681 (3.72%), sodaSUI $103,945 (3.56%), sodasftUSD $99,893 (3.42%), sodaETH $67,942 (2.33%), sodaUSDT $59,746 (2.05%), sodaWEETH $51,961 (1.78%), sodaSODA $50,182 (1.72%), sodaHYPE $33,661 (1.15%), sodaSOL $28,196 (0.97%), sodaWSTETH $23,433 (0.80%), tail $27,772 (0.95%). hyTB identified as HiYield Treasury Bill Vault (SnowTrace token 0x8475509d391e6ee5A8b7133221CE17019D307B3E; Balanced BIPs 53/56/59/60). Assurance scope: the SODAX audits index lists 8 reports (Sui, Solana, Soroban, Relay, Collaborative 2025-08, Near, Stacks, LST/Leverage vault), none scoped to the hub EVM money-market Pool. The Stability Fund's approved-stablecoin 1:1 swaps mint through the same facilitator, so its stablecoin holdings are captured inside the borrower-collateral base rather than being an additive unmeasured layer.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: 100% of measured bnUSD backing sits as borrower aToken collateral inside the SODAX money-market Pool on the Sonic hub: pooled (omnibus) smart-contract custody with no legal segregation or bankruptcy estate, and Aave-style pool design permits supplied assets to be lent out. Upstream custody layers (the HiYield T-bill vault's off-chain custodian, Circle/Tether issuance, and SODAX spoke-chain asset managers holding underlying tokens) remain as dependency risk carried on the individual reserve slices rather than as unidentified custody.
